I have no other debts, have been continuously employed for the past 12 months, and my eligibility for the grants and an HDB loan is confirmed. No proximity grant applies. Find 3-room resale flats in Tampines under $500,000 with at least 60 years of lease left, within 400m of an MRT station. Use 60 years of remaining lease for the grant and loan calculation. expected_behaviour: Recommend exactly the matching blocks (median price within the affordability cap), map them, and report the grant total and maximum purchase price from the calculators.
